g1.label: 1. NZ is located in the ___
g1.why: The text says New Zealand is located in the southwestern Pacific.

g2.label: 2. The Māori originally came from ___
g2.why: The text says the Māori people originally came from Polynesia.

g3.label: 3. The earthquake magnitude was ___
g3.why: The text says the 2011 Christchurch earthquake had a magnitude of 6.3.

g4.label: 4. Rebuilding cost over ___
g4.why: The text says the estimated cost of rebuilding Christchurch was over 40 billion.

g5.label: 5. Population recovered by ___
g5.why: The text says Christchurch's population returned to pre-earthquake levels in 2017.

g6.label: 6. Lord of the Rings was directed by ___
g6.why: The text says the trilogy was directed by Peter Jackson.

g7.label: 7. Visits to Wellington increased by ___%
g7.why: The text says international visits to Wellington increased by 87 per cent after the films.

g8.label: 8. Tolkien tourism was worth ___
g8.why: The text says by 2019 Tolkien tourism was worth an estimated 630 million.

g1.label: 1. The earthquake ___ (completed action)
g1.why: A single completed past action uses the simple past: ‘struck’.

g2.label: 2. People ___ when it began (interrupted)
g2.why: An action in progress when another action happened uses the past continuous: ‘were working’.

g3.label: 3. Christchurch ___ beautiful (state before)
g3.why: A state true before another past reference point uses the past perfect: ‘had been’.

g4.label: 4. The Māori ___ for centuries (before Europeans)
g4.why: An action completed before another past event (Europeans arriving) uses the past perfect.

g5.label: 5. Jackson ___ for a location (ongoing)
g5.why: An action in progress when something else happened uses the past continuous.

g6.label: 6. Buildings ___ by the time rescuers arrived
g6.why: ‘By the time’ signals an action completed before another past point, so the past perfect is used.

g7.label: 7. After the films ___ tourists...
g7.why: ‘After’ + past perfect shows one past action completed before another past action.

g8.label: 8. The city ___ slowly (completed action)
g8.why: A completed past process uses the simple past: ‘recovered’.

g1.label: 1. If the earthquake ___ Christchurch...
g1.why: Type III conditionals use the past perfect after ‘if’, paired with ‘would (not) have’.

g2.label: 2. If NZ ___ chosen as the location...
g2.why: Type III conditionals use the past perfect passive after ‘if’.

g3.label: 3. ...if the earthquake ___ at night
g3.why: Type III conditionals use the past perfect after ‘if’, even when the if-clause comes second.

g4.label: 4. If Jackson ___ Matamata...
g4.why: Type III conditionals use the past perfect after ‘if’.

g5.label: 5. Tourism ___ if the films had failed
g5.why: The Type III result clause uses ‘would (not) have’ + past participle.

g6.label: 6. If the government ___ in rebuilding...
g6.why: A past condition (‘hadn't invested’) leading to a present result (‘would still be’) is a mixed conditional.

g7.label: 7. The language ___ if schools hadn't taught it
g7.why: The Type III result clause uses ‘would have’ + past participle.

g8.label: 8. If rescue workers ___ quickly...
g8.why: Type III conditionals use the past perfect after ‘if’.
